flashcard_questions.q: Which Spanish king proposed marriage to Elizabeth in 1558?
What year did Elizabeth's Religious Settlement make England officially Protestant?
What year did the Pope excommunicate Elizabeth, encouraging Catholic powers to act against her?
Which 1585 treaty sent English troops and money to the Dutch rebels?
How many soldiers did Elizabeth send to the Netherlands under that 1585 treaty?
Who led the English forces sent to the Netherlands in 1585?
What term describes privately owned ships given unofficial royal permission to attack enemy vessels?
Where did Spanish forces attack English ships in 1568, deepening the bitterness between the nations?
Which English sailor sailed around the world between 1577 and 1580?
Which Spanish port did Drake raid in 1587, delaying the Armada?
What phrase described Drake's 1587 raid on the Spanish fleet's supplies?
In which month and year was Mary, Queen of Scots executed, giving Philip a reason for revenge?
Which fleet did Philip II send against England in 1588?

notes: 13 cards: 5 person-or-place to name, 3 event to date, 2 treaty-or-fleet, 2 term to definition, 1 quotation. A short lesson, so 13 is the honest ceiling without inventing detail; every figure here is stated in the content.
